description: Given a US street address and ZIP, return the owner of record and, if it is a business entity, its parent control group, how many homes the group holds and whether it is a large institutional investor under the ROAD Act (350+ homes). Coverage: entity-owned single-family homes in 17 large counties (Houston, Dallas, Fort Worth, San Antonio, Austin, Plano, Phoenix, Las Vegas, Atlanta metro, Tampa, Orlando, Jacksonville, Charlotte, Memphis).

address.description: Street address, e.g. '2746 Lofty Elm St'
